newsitem.title: USA: Healthcare Realty buys Lewis-Gale clinic.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare Realty buys Lewis-Gale clinic.

text.p: Healthcare Realty Trust announced on Monday it had completed its acquisition of Lewis-Gale Building Corp, which owns 10 properties in the Roanoke Valley area.
Healthcare Realty said in a statement it would turn the clinic into a subsidiary after it paid $43.5 million for it by issuing about 690,000 in common stock and assuming liabilities.
Two of the clinic's properties make up the 400-bed Columbia/Lewis-Gale Medical Center operated by Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp, it said.
The other eight properties are physician and medical office properties in the Roanoke Valley area leased to the Lewis-Gale Clinic and guaranteed by PhyCor Inc, it added.
Healthcare Realty, an equity real estate investment trust, said it would provide property management and lease administration services for all the facilities.
